services.heading: Tattoos
services.copy: Explore our unique tattoo designs crafted by talented artists. Each ink stroke tells a story—your story. Let us help you express yourself.

services.heading: Piercings
services.copy: Add a little sparkle to your look with our professional piercing services. From ears to noses, we ensure a safe and stylish experience.

services.heading: Tooth Gems
services.copy: Brighten your smile with our stylish tooth gems! Shine in every conversation with a touch of bling that’s truly you.

services.heading: Microblading
services.copy: Wake up with perfect brows! Our microblading services create natural-looking, fuller eyebrows, tailored just for you.

services.heading: Teeth Whitening
services.copy: Achieve a radiant smile with our professional teeth whitening treatments. Smile brighter and boost your confidence instantly.

services.heading: Aftercare Tips
services.copy: Take good care of your new ink, piercing, or gems! Our aftercare tips will guide you to ensure your body art stays fresh and vibrant.

artists.name: Rigo
artists.copy: Works in black-and-grey and illustrative styles with clean lines and smooth blends.

artists.name: Jake
artists.copy: Blends graphic elements with black-and-grey shading for clear, readable designs.

artists.name: Megan
artists.copy: Specializes in cosmetic tooth gems and teeth whitening, providing safe application with quality materials.

artists.name: Sonny
artists.copy: Provides precise, professional piercings using sterile technique and implant-grade jewelry.

roulette.heading: Spin the Wheel of Ink and Uncover Your Next Tattoo!
roulette.copy: Ready for something unique? Our Ink Roulette is designed for thrill-seekers! Spin the wheel, and let fate guide you to an exciting tattoo design. It’s not just about the ink; it’s about embracing adventure and expressing your individuality. Whether you’re a tattoo newbie or a seasoned collector, there’s something waiting just for you!

reviews.heading: Hear it straight from our awesome clients

items.quote: "I love this shop! I've had both tattoos and piercings done here, and they always turn out amazing They have a clean, friendly, and welcoming atmosphere. The staff are all very knowledgeable, professional, and kind. They are also very affordable! Jake and James are my favorite, but I'd recommend any of the artists/piercers there! 100/10!! I know I'll definitely be a long returning client of theirs "
items.name: Dakota Fuller

items.quote: "I absolutely loveeeeee this tattoo shop!! I have gotten my last 3 tattoos from them and my dad has gotten one as well and all the time I have been everyone has been super nice and the environment is very welcoming! Every artist there does amazing work and they are very accommodating. Highly recommend this shop for your next tattoo!"
items.name: Ashleigh Jensen

items.quote: "I know the owner and he’s super dope. He gave me an awesome tattoo and I love it. He’s got a light touch and checked to make sure I was okay throughout the tattoo. He answered all my questions and concerns and I couldn’t be happier with the result of my tat!"
items.name: Kayla Burnett

items.quote: "This shop is so clean! Jake was light handed and hit the fine lines of my tattoo are exceptional. A fun warm welcome and very comfortable seating. I'll be back for more ink in the future."
items.name: Jessica Repman
